newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - Portugal 5-yr bonds may not all be placed.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Portugal 5-yr bonds may not all be placed.

text.p: Bids at the auction of five-year Portuguese bonds were seen at between 5.70-5.80 percent, in line with the secondary market, but the uncertainty surrounding the French elections may push the rate closer to 5.80 percent, dealers said.
If the bidded yields were regarded as too high, the Institute for Public Credit Management (IGCP) could opt not to place the full 25 billion escudos on offer, they added.
At the last such sale on April 22, the IGCP placed 25 billion escudos at an average rate of 6.1998 percent. The paper closed at 5.76 percent on the over-the-counter market on Monday.
Traders said that investment funds probably saw levels between 5.70 and 5.80 percent as a good buying opportunity but the uncertainties surrounding the French election could induce caution.
"I don't think the IGCP will accept bids much above 5.80 percent. That could be the cut-off point," said one trader.
European bond markets fell on Monday after Sunday's surprise win by the left in first round voting in French parliamentary elections.
